subject: Hosted API upgrade orchestration — onboarding schedule & invoice timing
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex@cloudware.io>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@cloudware.io>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API capacity increase & billing cadence questions

Hi Naomi / Karthik —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Cloudware is ready to move forward with a higher committed plan for the hosted API. A few specifics we need to lock down so procurement can cut a PO this week:

- Target commit: 1.2B generated tokens / month (expected steady-state by month 2) with a soft-burst cushion of 250M tokens for month 1 only.
- Desired start date: Oct 15, 2027.
- Billing ask: Can we invoice monthly with a proration for the partial month (Oct 15–31)? Procurement prefers monthly invoices versus quarterly.
- Rate limits: We need a lane that supports sustained 200 rps spikes for short windows (5–10 minutes). Please confirm whether that requires a Dedicated pool or can be covered by Hosted with burst policy and what guardrails apply.

I've attached our internal estimate of expected token distribution across services (Cloudware_MAAP_SOW_v2.pdf). Procurement (cc'd) needs a simple invoice schedule so they can attach it to the PO.

Next steps from our side: if you can confirm start date, onboarding timeline, and the first-invoice amount (prorated), we'll trigger the PO.

Thanks —
Alex
Alex Chen
Head of AI Platform, Cloudware Inc.
[Attachment: Cloudware_MAAP_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF)]

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: Alex Chen <alex@cloudware.io>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, Priya Singh <priya@cloudware.io>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API capacity increase & billing cadence questions

Alex —

Appreciate the fast turnaround. We can support the plan; below is an operationally-safe onboarding proposal and the billing approach that aligns with our hosted model. If that looks good, I'll circulate SOW + the invoice schedule for signature/PO.

Onboarding & capacity plan (proposed):
- Oct 15: Provisioning window opens. We will reserve a hosted commit pool sized for 700M tokens/month (step 1) + 250M soft-burst for first 30 days as requested.
- Nov 1: Step up to the full 1.2B/month commit. This two-step ramp reduces initial provisioning overhead and gives ops time to validate latency under load.
- Soft-burst handling: soft-burst is applied as a prioritized queue; sustained sustained exceedances will fall back to rate-limited responses after the 250M cushion is exhausted.
- Rate/latency target: We will target 95th %-ile generation latency comparable to our hosted SLOs; sustained 200 rps spikes are supported by the burst policy but may see short-lived queueing if multiple concurrent spikes hit different regions.

Billing & invoicing:
- Monthly invoices. First invoice will be prorated for Oct 15–31 based on the step 1 committed capacity (700M). Invoice schedule attached (invoice_schedule.xlsx).
- Standard payment terms: Net 30. If procurement needs Net 45, note that in the PO and we'll route to Finance for approval; that may add 2–3 business days.

Required items to begin provisioning:
1) Signed SOW (we'll send v2 with the above ramp schedule).
2) PO referencing deal id DW-2027-1147 and stating the start date Oct 15.
3) Contact for ops onboarding (Priya is cc'd; please confirm the primary contact and any IP allowlists).

I'll attach the SOW and invoice schedule in the next message once legal signs off on one minor term (short, non-substantive).

Best,
Naomi
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: invoice_schedule.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Alex Chen <alex@cloudware.io>, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@cloudware.io>, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API capacity increase & billing cadence questions

Alex / Naomi —

Quick note on pricing/commit tiers and a couple of commercial guardrails so procurement has clarity for the PO.

Proposed commercial structure for DW-2027-1147:
- Committed tier 1 (Oct 15–Oct 31): 700M tokens/month — unit price $0.00012 / generated token (prorated for the final invoice).
- Committed tier 2 (Nov onward): 1.2B tokens/month — blended unit price $0.00010 / generated token.
- Soft-burst cushion (250M first-month only): billed at overage rate $0.00018 / token if consumed beyond cushion in month 1.
- Overages after cushion (month 2+): standard overage rate $0.00015 / token.

Commercial notes:
- Minimum contract term: 12 months from Nov 1 (the full-commit effective date). Early termination has a prorated true-up.
- If you anticipate seasonality that exceeds 1.4B tokens regularly, recommend Reserved (Dedicated) for predictable throughput; we can discuss a migration path later.
- Downgrade notice: 30 days for commit reductions; increases can be applied with a 14-day notice in most cases.

Technical controls & rate limiting:
- For the requested 200 rps sustained spike windows (5–10 minutes), hosted burst policy will cover short windows. If you require guaranteed steady sustained QPS at that level without queueing, we'll need a Dedicated pool and an SLA addendum.
- Canary rollout: we'll enable a canary for your traffic for the first 72 hours after each step-up to monitor latency regressions.

If this commercial outline works, Naomi — please attach the updated SOW with these rates and we can hand to procurement.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Alex Chen <alex@cloudware.io>, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@cloudware.io>, Cloudware Procurement <procurement@cloudware.io>
Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2027 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API capacity increase & billing cadence questions

Looping in a quick ops confirmation before we queue provisioning. A few pragmatic constraints to note: 

- Lead time: To guarantee the burst cushion and step-up without throttling, we need the signed SOW + PO by Oct 6 COB (PST). Anything later pushes the start date out 7–10 business days while we allocate capacity.
- Provisioning details: We'll apply a tenant-level prefixed quota, create an onboarding runbook, and enable prefix/KV cache warmup during the Oct 15–Nov 1 ramp. Expect two onboarding sessions (ops + dev).
- Rate-limiter behaviour: If the burst cushion is exhausted we enforce token-based overage rates and degraded priority queueing for non-critical requests. Please provide a prioritized list of API routes so we can map critical traffic to hot paths.
- SLO exceptions: If Cloudware requires hard SLAs for sustained 200 rps, we must convert to Dedicated and attach the SLA addendum to the PO.

Quoted for context: 
> On Wed, Sep 29, 2027 at 12:20 PM Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Onboarding & capacity plan (proposed):
> > - Oct 15: Provisioning window opens. We will reserve a hosted commit pool sized for 700M tokens/month (step 1) + 250M soft-burst for first 30 days as requested.
> > - Nov 1: Step up to the full 1.2B/month commit. This two-step ramp reduces initial provisioning overhead and gives ops time to validate latency under load.

Action items: 
1) Alex / Procurement: confirm PO issued by Oct 6 and attach signed SOW (Cloudware_MAAP_SOW_v2.pdf).
2) Priya: send prioritized list of routes and a contact for allowlist (CIDR/IP).
3) Naomi: send final SOW + billing table and I'll schedule the provisioning runbook meeting for Oct 11.

I'll stand up the runbook once SOW + PO are in.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
